an9.94:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya nava dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an9.94:1.3: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ, saññāvedayitanirodho,
an9.94:1.4: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
